svg.title: SQLHadoopMapReduceCommitProtocol -- Dynamic Staging
svg.desc: .spark-staging-<uuid>, transient executor FileOutputCommitter, OutputCommitCoordinator gate, & dir swap. 1. FileFormatWriter to Driver CommitProto: setupJob(.spark-staging) (in-JVM); 2. Task Attempt to Task CommitProto: Alloc east/west workPath (in-JVM); 3. Task Attempt to HDFS DataNode: Write staged .parquet (:9866); 4. Task CommitProto to OutputCommitCoord: AskCommitOutput(s17,p7) (:41000); 5. Task CommitProto to FileFormatWriter: TaskCommitMsg(east,west) (:41000); 6. Driver CommitProto to HDFS NameNode: Replace east/west & clean (:8020)
